description: This file defines a class and functions for creating and managing EfficientNet-based backbones for RetinaNet object detection models, including downloading ImageNet weights and validating backbone configurations.

classes.name: EfficientNetBackbone
classes.description: A class representing an EfficientNet backbone for RetinaNet, providing methods for downloading weights, validation, and preprocessing images.

methods.name: retinanet
methods.description: Constructs a RetinaNet model using an EfficientNet backbone with specified parameters.
